questions.coherence: Mostly one design. M18.225 and M18.228 extend last-ci's single CI reader rather than adding a second one, and land.mjs consumes its --red-file. M18.144 and M18.227 share one predicate, catchesFrom(KEEPS_FOCUS), for both the keydown route and the event/wait path (use-system-clipboard.ts 'free'). M18.111 splits validation (sdk loadPackConnectors over core parseConnectorDefs) from registration (routing registerConnectorDefs), as layering requires, and records this in an ADR-0048 amendment. Two incoherences: the headroom step picks 'the previous run' as the newest completed main run of any conclusion (ci.yml:69), while last-ci walks reds back to the newest green. Neither excludes cancelled runs consistently (F5). And M18.227 had to undo half of M18.144's comment within 80 minutes, because M18.144's design ('the browser's event does the chord') was never run on the two engines it described.

questions.gateHonesty: The completion gate is not the issue at this checkpoint, but three harness gates are softer than they look. (a) The review round cap can be reset by replaying another row's digest lines onto main. nextRound closes every landed line, so M18.35 (r4 pass past cap 3, no allowance on main) and M18.218 now restart at r1 (F2). (b) last-ci's red list admits cancelled runs, so a Fixes-ci can name a cancelled run (F5). (c) The headroom step degrades to --warn-only whenever the newest completed run has no artifact, for example a cancelled run (F5). Spot-checked tests, each imagining a mutant. The zip.test.ts overlap case (period 1, 3 and 7 and the limit to the byte) kills a copyWithin chunk size that does not grow with outPos, and an off-by-one in reserve(). The utf8.test.ts chunk-crossing case (8191 ASCII then '€', strict 0xff at 9000) kills a decodeChunk that drops a sequence spanning the 8 KiB boundary. register-connector-defs.test.ts asserts keys(r) unchanged after each refusal, which kills a non-atomic register. M18.227's browser test fails before the fix, per its commit, and the tip e2e is green on all engines. These tests constrain.
